messages.subject: bug
parts:
Hi everyone,

I caught an important bug related to gmultmix. It should only have
been a problem if you were using parboot on a model fit with gmultmix.
The simulate method was not working properly but it is now fixed. You
can see specific changes here
http://github.com/rbchan/unmarked/commits/master. I'll try to release
a new version soon.

Sorry about that.

Richard
